preconditions.description: The number of tournaments n and sports k are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(powers) == n and all(len(row) == k for row in powers)
preconditions.description: There are exactly n rows of powers, each containing exactly k integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= val <= 10**9 for row in powers for val in row)
preconditions.description: All power values are positive integers within the allowed range.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(col)) == n for col in zip(*powers))
preconditions.description: For each sport kind, all power values across all sportsmen are distinct.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n lines, one for each tournament.
Each output line is a non-negative integer representing the count of possible winners.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == count_possible_winners(powers[:i+1], k) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each tournament i (0-indexed), the output is the count of sportsmen among the first i+1 participants who can win the tournament under some valid bracket and sport assignment.
